arabicMentorExplanation: شو الفكرة؟ الطب الطارئ العالمي بركز على حل المشكلة حسب شكوى المريض مش بس التشخيص. وين الفخ؟ الشغل الإنساني (فزعة) بختلف عن شغل التطوير (بناء نظام). كيف أستخدمها؟ تذكر إنه GEM شامل لكل الأعمار والحالات.

keyPoints: GED guidelines consist of 40 specific recommendations across six categories: Staffing, Equipment, Education, Policies, Transitions, and Quality Improvement.
Education should focus on atypical presentations, cognitive disorders, and medication management.
Evaluation by a physical therapist in the ED after a fall significantly decreases the likelihood of a repeat fall within 30 days.
relatedTraps: Proper technique for central line placement is NOT part of the geriatric-specific GED recommendations.
boardSafeLogic: Geriatric-specific care models focus on multi-disciplinary evaluation to address the complexity of aging physiology and social support.
arabicMentorExplanation: شو الفكرة؟ توصيات خاصة لكبار السن بالطوارئ. وين الفخ؟ تقييم 'المعالج الفيزيائي' بالذات بقلل احتمالية وقوع المريض مرة تانية خلال شهر. كيف أستخدمها؟ لو سألك عن شيء بقلل تكرار الزيارات بعد الوقوع، الجواب (Physical Therapy).

keyPoints: Documentation must focus on physical characteristics: size, shape, location, and presence of soot or stippling.
Emergency clinicians should NOT label wounds as 'entrance' or 'exit' as this is often inaccurate and leads to legal pitfalls.
Avoid estimating the caliber of the bullet based on the wound appearance.
relatedTraps: Speculating on the bullet's trajectory or caliber in the medical record can be used to discredit medical testimony in court.
boardSafeLogic: Precise descriptive language is superior to forensic interpretation for non-forensic specialists.
arabicMentorExplanation: شو الفكرة؟ توثيق جروح الرصاص. وين الفخ؟ ممنوع تكتب 'مدخل' أو 'مخرج' (Entrance/Exit) بالتقرير الطبي. كيف أستخدمها؟ بس أوصف الجرح (مكان، قطر، حروق حوله) واترك التفسير للطب الشرعي.

keyPoints: Air Medical Transport (AMT) is indicated when distance prevents timely ground transport to a PCI-capable center.
'Hot loading' (loading the patient while helicopter engines are running) significantly reduces door-in-door-out (DIDO) times.
DIDO time target is generally <30 minutes for optimal outcomes.
relatedTraps: Do NOT delay transport for stable STEMI patients to perform secondary imaging or wait for lab results.
relatedFocusedQuestionFamilies: ACS / Chest Pain / Cardiovascular Risk Stratification
boardSafeLogic: Time-to-reperfusion is the primary driver of survival in STEMI; all transport logistics should minimize idle time.
arabicMentorExplanation: شو الفكرة؟ نقل مرضى الجلطة بالهليكوبتر. وين الفخ؟ حركة (Hot loading) إنك تحمل المريض والمحركات شغالة بتوفر وقت ثمين جداً. كيف أستخدمها؟ أي تأخير في الـ (DIDO) لأكثر من 30 دقيقة هو مؤشر جودة سيء.

keyPoints: Secondary Assessment of Victim Endpoint (SAVE) is used in the 'wait' phase of disasters when resources are overwhelmed.
Triage decisions are based on the probability of survival with the available resources.
Differs from START triage, which is used for immediate sorting at the scene.
relatedTraps: SAVE is NOT for day-to-day triage; it is an extreme resource-allocation tool for prolonged disaster response.
boardSafeLogic: In scenarios where patients cannot be evacuated, treatment is prioritized for those most likely to benefit, rather than the most critically ill.
arabicMentorExplanation: شو الفكرة؟ ترياج (SAVE) في الكوارث الكبيرة. وين الفخ؟ هون القرار بيعتمد على 'مين اللي رح يعيش لو استهلكنا عليه مواردنا'، مش مين اللي حالته أخطر. كيف أستخدمها؟ لو السؤال عن كارثة مطولة وما في إخلاء، استعمل SAVE.

topic: Mass Casualty Triage and Utstein Template
keyPoints: Utstein template standardizes cardiac arrest data.
Disaster triage prioritizes survival probability and resources.
tables: Utstein template for cardiac arrest data.
relatedTraps: Day-to-day triage differs from MCI triage.

keyPoints: Downsloping ST elevation in V1-V2 with RBBB-like pattern.
High risk of sudden cardiac death.
relatedTraps: Do not mistake Brugada for simple STEMI.

keyPoints: Norepinephrine is first-line vasopressor after fluids.
Target MAP usually 65 mmHg.
relatedTraps: Avoid dopamine as first-line when norepinephrine is available.

keyPoints: Capnography measures ventilation and CPR quality.
X portion represents expiratory plateau.
relatedTraps: Sudden sustained rise in ETCO2 may indicate ROSC.

keyPoints: Lethal triad: coagulopathy, acidosis, hypothermia.
MTP often follows 1:1:1 PRBC:FFP:Platelets.
relatedTraps: Over-resuscitation with crystalloid worsens coagulopathy.

keyPoints: Symptoms include tongue numbness, seizures, cardiovascular collapse.
Treatment is IV 20% lipid emulsion.
relatedTraps: Avoid vasopressin and high-dose epinephrine in LAST arrest.

keyPoints: Ketamine preserves respiratory drive and blood pressure.
Laryngospasm is rare but serious, especially in children.
relatedTraps: Match dosing to analgesia vs dissociation goal.

keyPoints: Staples are fast for long linear lacerations.
Staples provide least precise closure.
relatedTraps: Avoid staples where cosmetic precision matters, such as face.

keyPoints: Lid margin, lacrimal duct, orbital fat, ptosis are danger findings.
relatedTraps: Visible orbital fat or medial canthus injury requires specialist repair.

keyPoints: Initial treatment includes aspirin, nitroglycerin, benzodiazepines.
relatedTraps: Avoid beta-blockers in cocaine chest pain board-style convention.

keyPoints: Beck triad plus POCUS findings: effusion, RV collapse, plethoric IVC.
relatedTraps: Pericardiocentesis is for unstable tamponade, not stable effusion.

keyPoints: Sinus tachycardia can be the most common physical finding.
Small stable primary PTX may be observed.
relatedTraps: Observation applies to selected primary PTX, not secondary PTX.

keyPoints: Peptic ulcer disease is common cause; lactate elevation predicts worse outcomes.
relatedTraps: Do not delay PPI while awaiting endoscopy in ulcer-related UGIB.

keyPoints: Esophageal button batteries are emergencies; coin orientation differs in esophagus vs trachea.
relatedTraps: Do not use meat tenderizer for food impactions.

keyPoints: Perineal necrotizing fasciitis; needs immediate debridement and broad antibiotics.
relatedTraps: Do not delay surgery for CT if clinical suspicion is high.

keyPoints: Hypotension is common after dialysis due to ultrafiltration.
relatedTraps: Check glucose; hypotension may mask hypoglycemia in diabetic dialysis patient.

keyPoints: Heterotopic pregnancy risk rises with ovulation induction/assisted reproduction.
relatedTraps: IUP does not rule out ectopic in assisted reproduction.

keyPoints: PROM is rupture before labor; ferning test helps diagnosis.
relatedTraps: Avoid routine digital pelvic exam in suspected PROM.

keyPoints: Ultrasound target/doughnut sign; common cause of obstruction in young children.
relatedTraps: Do not wait for currant jelly stools; late sign.

Treat life threats before decontamination.
